SKYWAY 7
TO THE GATE DISTRICT: 1.9 KM

params.detail: Follow the bridge north, toward the Gate district.
Hostiles ahead on the bridge. Use the wrecks for cover.
Pass the barricade and cross to the far end of the bridge.
Shoot the glowing weak spots on its three heads. Stay in cover.
